title: The Soldier Who Fought for 29 More Years

scenes.say: This soldier kept fighting World War Two for twenty nine years after it ended.
In 1944, Japanese officer Hiroo Onoda was sent to a small island in the Philippines.
His orders were simple. Never surrender. We will come back for you.
In 1945, the war ended. Leaflets fell from the sky telling him so. He decided they were a trick.
scenes.sub: is what he thought the leaflets were

scenes.say: So he stayed in the jungle. For years. Then for decades.
His three companions were lost, one by one, until he was alone.
In 1974, a young traveler went looking for him, and found him.
But Onoda refused to leave, until his old commander flew in and ordered him to stop.
He handed over his sword, twenty nine years late.
